items.heading: The Institute of Chartered Accountants
items.text: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India publishes its own course rules. Its course FAQ says Foundation registration is open after Class 10 and that the first attempt needs Class 12, with Intermediate reached through Foundation or direct entry and a two-year practical training. Read the current ICAI notice before planning.
